title: Prompt snippets authoring flow - scratch
content:
Purpose / context:
Quick brain dump for an authoring flow that surfaces reusable 'prompt snippets' (small composable instructions / constraints / boilerplate) for product teams and prompt engineers inside Redwood Console / Prompt Studio. This is a user-facing mini-PRD + scratchpad — mostly to capture hypotheses and an MVP outline.

Problem we're solving:
- Teams waste time copy-pasting brittle prompt fragments across projects.
- Hard to version and audit small prompt building blocks (safety text, system instructions, persona blips, example pairs).
- Reuse is ad-hoc: shared docs, GH gists, private notes — no product-integrated discoverability or attribution.
- Changing a base snippet requires manual edits across prompts — leads to regressions.

Hypothesis:
- If we provide a lightweight snippet registry + inline authoring UX with metadata (owner, tags, cost hints, jurisdiction notes), teams will adopt snippets for >30% of new prompt templates within 3 months and reduce regressions in eval runs by 10%.

Primary users:
- Prompt engineers / ML engineers building templates for a product flow
- Product engineers integrating prompts into backend routes
- Solutions/SEs maintaining customer-specific prompt variants
- Compliance reviewers looking for redaction/safety snippets

Examples of snippet types (brainstorm):
- System-level persona: "concise-legal-explainer-v1" (keeps responses <120 tokens, uses plain language)
- Safety guard: "no-personal-data-emit-v2" (explicit deny list + redaction instruction)
- Example pair bundle: "ticket-resolution-examples" (3 positive, 2 negative)
- Post-processing directive: "strip-urls-keep-domain"
- Cost hint: "compressive-mode" (encourages shorter outputs; estimated -15% tokens)

Key features (MVP-ish):
- Create / edit snippet UI (title, description, tags, sample inputs, sample outputs, owner, visibility: org/team/private)
- Insert snippet into template via autocomplete in Prompt Studio (slash command)
- Inline preview: example output, estimated token delta (rough), safety score indicator (heuristic)
- Versioning: simple version history + ability to pin snippet version in a template
- Basic access controls and audit: owner, last editor, linked ticket/PR
- Simple import/export (JSON pack) for sharing across workspaces

Desired UX flows (sketch):
1) Create: From Prompt Studio -> Snippets panel -> New snippet -> quick WYSIWYG 
   - Required fields: title, body (raw instruction), type, visibility
   - Optional: sample_io, cost_hint, compliance_notes, linked_ticket
2) Insert: While editing template, type "/" -> shows snippet index (filtered by tags/recency) -> insert expands to a placeholder token in the prompt body (e.g., {{snippet:concise-legal-explainer-v1@v2}})
3) Pinning/Resolution: When deploying template, user chooses whether to pin to snippet version or float (auto-use latest). If float, changes to snippet reflect immediately but warn on deploy.
4) Audit: Console view for snippet usages across templates and routes (which templates reference it, last eval regressions)

User stories (raw):
- As a prompt engineer, I want to save a standard 'customer-tone' snippet so I can apply the same voice across templates without rewriting.
- As a product engineer, I want to see the estimated token delta when inserting a snippet so I can reason about cost impact on a route.
- As a compliance reviewer, I want to mark a snippet as 'blocked-in-eu' so it can't be used in EU-configured templates.
- As an SRE/ops user, I want to know which templates float the latest snippet vs pinned so we can trace regressions back to snippet changes.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Create/insert/pin flows implemented and validated in Prompt Studio beta
- Snippet index searchable by title/tags and shows owner + last modified
- Deploy-time warning when a floating snippet differs from the version used in last successful eval
- Basic token delta heuristic shown (server-side estimate for a small sample)

Metrics / signals to watch:
- Adoption: percent of new templates using snippets (target > 30% in first 90 days)
- Reuse depth: median number of templates per snippet (goal > 2)
- Regression linkage: percent of eval regressions attributable to snippet changes (want to detect and surface)
- Time-saved qualitative: notes from SEs/PMs in pilot

Technical considerations (notes):
- Storage model: snippets as small versioned documents in metadata DB (id, versions[], visibility, owner, tags). Keep body text and sample_io plain text.
- When inserting, materialize placeholder with metadata reference (id@version). At render time, replace with canonical body using renderer service (keeps template small).
- Token delta heuristic: compute difference on a small set of representative inputs or use averaged model-based estimate via lightweight tokenizer metrics. Need guardrails for variable-length outputs.
- Security: sanitize snippet bodies (no embedded executable markdown or foreign references). Treat snippet content as untrusted when surfaced in evals.

Open questions / Risks:
- Ownership: Should snippet changes notify downstream template owners? (Probably yes — need notification UX + opt-in)
- Governance: allow org-level curated snippet sets vs personal ones. How to handle overrides?
- Migration: how to import existing prompt components from GH gists / Confluence automatically?
- Cost estimation accuracy: how do we avoid misleading delta numbers? Display ranges + confidence.
- Edge case: dynamic snippets containing placeholders that depend on runtime variables — do we allow runtime interpolation?

Implementation rough plan (phases):
- Phase 0: design workshop + schema proposal + API sketch (1 week)
- Phase 1 (MVP): CRUD UI in Prompt Studio, insert UX, server-side snippet store, simple token estimator, version pinning (4 weeks)
- Phase 2: audit/usage dashboard, visibility controls, import/export, notification hooks (3–4 weeks)
- Phase 3: advanced features: snippet composition (snippets referencing other snippets), snippet evals / canary changes (A/B of snippet versions), org marketplace (6+ weeks)

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Talk to Mika about safety heuristics (she had a small 'safety snippets' notebook)
- Ask Ravi for a rough token estimator prototype (he did cost-sim sandbox)
- Design: get initial mock for insert modal from Jordan (ask in #prompt-studio)
- Check legal on 'export' artifact policy (CON-4821)

Rough PCI / compliance flags:
- Prohibit storing PII in snippet samples by default; show reminder when user saves sample_io that contains email/address-like patterns.

Random UX ideas (parking lot):
- Snippet badges (e.g., "low-cost", "safety-verified", "eu-safe")
- A 'quick test' button that runs a small prompt with sample input and shows delta vs baseline
- Snippet diffs: visually show what changed between versions, and let reviewer comment inline

Unresolved naming: "snippet" vs "fragment" vs "component". I like snippet — short and familiar.

Personal notes (tiny):
- Keep MVP tight: create/insert/pin + token delta + search. Everything else is nice-to-have.
- Ship a beta to 3 internal teams (SE, CS, 2 pilot customers) for fast feedback.

----
End of scratch. Will iterate after initial sync with design + safety + cost teams.
